title: The Why We Wait for the Last Person
youtube_title: The Why We Wait for the Last Person | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Farah about why the house waits for the last person before the story. Farah wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
